newsitem.title: USA: NiGas extends gas withdrawal limits.
newsitem.headline: NiGas extends gas withdrawal limits.

text.p: Northern Illinois Gas Co (NiGas) said Friday it will extend its "critical day" period through Monday, limiting natural gas storage withdrawals from its underground facilities for three consecutive days.
NiGas, a unit of NICOR Inc, has seven underground storage facilities throughout Illinois.

A critical day, which will affect gas deliveries for Saturday, Sunday and Monday deliveries, can be declared from November 1 to April 1 when storage withdrawals and supplies from NiGas based on contracted quantities need to be limited.
Any additional gas used by the customer will be charged at $6.00 per therm plus the cost of the gas, the company said.
Earlier, Natural Gas Pipeline also said it has declared a "critical time" for Saturday deliveries due to the cold, limiting shippers to only nominated gas.
NGPL runs from western Texas to Illinois.
Early cash prices at the Chicago city-gate soared to as high as $6.50 per mmBtu, but as nomination deadlines neared prices retreated to about $4.50.
